## What's new
- **Much faster setup**: add-ons now install with uv instead of pip. On a test laptop, setup dropped from about 4 minutes to about 1.
- **Forecasts right away**: the app shows today's forecast from the public page within seconds of starting, while your computer builds its own in the background (about 15-30 minutes the first time). The page switches over by itself when it's done.

## Download
Under **Assets** below, click **Prolepsis-….zip** (not "Source code"), then unzip it.

- **Windows 10/11:** open the `Prolepsis` folder and double-click **`Start Stock Forecast.bat`**.
  If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac (M1 or newer, macOS 14+):** right-click **`Start Stock Forecast (Mac).command`** and choose **Open**.
- **Linux:** open a terminal in the folder and run `bash "Start Stock Forecast (Linux).sh"`.

The first start sets itself up (usually 1-5 minutes, about 0.5 GB, nothing installed on your computer).
Forecasts show up within seconds after that.

Don't want to download anything? Open the live page: https://faizsyed13.github.io/Prolepsis---Future-of-stock-forecasting/

Research project, not financial advice.
